title_cn: 特朗普转向对“根深蒂固”的伊朗政权进行经济挤压
summary:
The US military campaign against Iran has so far failed to force the regime to capitulate. The Trump administration is betting once again that suffocating economic pressure will do the job.
Harrison Mann, former US Army Major and Associate Director for Campaigns & Policy at Win Without War, discusses Iran strategic mishaps, munitions concerns, and the mental health among Navy sailors as they hit a record 250 days at sea. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hungary Casts Doubt on Nuclear Plant Expansion After Danube Woes
title_cn: 多瑙河灾难后匈牙利对核电站扩建表示怀疑
summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar cast doubt on the Russian-led expansion of the country’s sole nuclear power plant after the record-low level of the Danube river almost led to a full shutdown of the existing reactors.

title: Poland Says Russian Plot to Kill Ukrainian-US Citizen Thwarted
title_cn: 波兰称俄罗斯刺杀乌克兰裔美国公民的阴谋被挫败
summary: Poland said its security services prevented the assassination of a US citizen originally from Ukraine that was ordered by Russian intelligence.
